svg.title: Static reservation vs paged allocation
svg.desc: Four variable-length sequences show lower unused-slot arithmetic with 16-token blocks than reserving 128 token slots for every request.
svg.text: Reserve for maximum length vs allocate on demand
Four contexts · live tokens = 161 · block size = 16 · static reservation = 128 per request
Arithmetic reduction in unused slots: 91.17% · not a measured serving gain.
